items.prompt: A function is declared, called from main and never defined in the standalone build. Which stage usually reports the missing definition?

options.text: Lexical preprocessing before any types exist
options.why: The declaration can be processed normally.

options.text: Linking object code and required definitions
options.why: A declaration alone is not the linked implementation.

options.text: Only the first successful production order
options.why: The build should fail before a complete executable is produced.

options.text: The grader must label every such case correct
options.why: A missing linked implementation is a build failure.

items.explanation: The standalone object may compile, but the missing definition prevents the normal complete link.
